headline: Denied seven motor vehicle excise tax abatements and approved abatements for the week of June 8 to June 12 by signatures.
summary: The board reviewed minutes from a prior meeting and handled motor vehicle excise tax abatement applications. Abatements for the week of June 8 to June 12 were approved by signatures, while seven other applications were denied.
decisions: Approved the minutes from the June 11, 2026 meeting.
Approved motor vehicle excise abatements for the week of June 8 to June 12 by signatures.
Denied seven motor vehicle excise abatement applications.

the minutes, E. Brideau 2nd – Unanimous.
